708:### 27. An empty read range returns a snapshot after compaction

item.text:
The audit now has 27 confirmed findings. This pass added a deterministic range-semantics defect:

- **An empty log range returns a snapshot after compaction.** `read_entries(1..1)` correctly returned an empty vector before compaction, but after snapshotting at index 2 it returned the snapshot for index 2—a non-empty entry outside the requested interval. The end bound is classified before checking for an empty range: [audit_read_empty_range.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_read_empty_range.rs).

The higher-impact new synchronization finding remains: `AcceptSync` can decrease a follower’s decided index from 10 to 5, violating monotonic decided visibility.

Complete findings, affected code, necessary conditions, and retained logs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
